instructions:
Repair factual errors and answer coherence against the SAME frozen source records and comparison_pairs. The editorial_plan contains identities and comparison targets only, never source facts or a mandate to recommend every selected record. Recheck each sentence against the exact referenced option, including program, cabin, carriers, connection wait, time metric and original quote scope. A temporal card supports only its exact pair and metric, not surrounding prose. Remove unsupported claims and contradictions; keep useful supported tradeoffs and applicable limits. You may delete a weak or redundant option, but also repair or delete dependent comparison cards. Do not invent a benefit for every alternative. The previous_wire.blocks entries each carry an original index and one original block. Return ONLY {edits:[{start,end,blocks}]}: each edit must have end=start+1 and blocks containing zero or one complete replacement block. No insertion, multi-block replacement or multi-block range is allowed. Use original positions in sorted order. Empty edits mean no change, not factual approval. Keep internal J/A/C/T/JP/CP aliases out of traveler prose and labels; keep them only in wire reference fields. Feedback lists actual failed mechanical findings and may be empty. The requested traveler count is known from the request; use each selected journey's traveler_evidence to identify award versus cash component support that remains unverified. Missing returned travelers is not a failed seat check, and cash echo does not verify award support. Repair a missing central decision reason when the exact source supports one, especially a conditional next-check preference among incomplete leads by date, program, or comparable original quote. Do not invent program access, balances, total savings, or a benefit from surplus seats above the requested party. Preserve factual repair priority; one existing paragraph may be rewritten as one block.
Write for the traveler. Call the supplied material search results, not a packet or an internal validation workflow. Report amounts as source quotes and preserve unknown scope. Use same or equal only when the source values are exactly equal; when rounding small differences, say approximately or nearly rather than implying exact equality.
